forum.content_text:
For example, in this post:

<https://community.st.com/stm32-mcus-products-25/some-example-projects-don-t-use-ioc-file-136681?postid=599233#post599233>

I use this link to a specific post in another thread:

[https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus-embedded-software/stm32cubemx-file-for-the-stm32h747i-disco-usb-webcam-example/m-p/745530**/highlight/true#M57279**](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus-embedded-software/stm32cubemx-file-for-the-stm32h747i-disco-usb-webcam-example/m-p/745530/highlight/true#M57279)

But that doesn’t work - it gets directed to <https://community.st.com/#M57279> - which just shows the “home” page of the new community.

If I remove the /highlight/true#M57279 part, it seems to work.
